$comment: The staff homepage's weekly updates (issue 9), written by Daniel Peak, the Director of Communications. Each Monday's update has one feature and one to three staff articles. A feature or article with an 'occasion' runs on the Monday 'weeksBefore' weeks before that occasion's week: 0 is the Monday of its week, and a negative number is a week after it. An occasion is one the message library already dates (README.md), or event:<key> for a calendar event. Mondays with no occasion feature take the next evergreen feature, and articles fill to the week's count from the evergreen ones. A feature's image is an approved event image by event key. An article's image is its author's staff photo; 'author' is a staff member's household/member key. README.md has the rules, and check-news.js checks them.

features.title: Staff Retreat Next Week
text: Our staff retreat is next Wednesday. We will look back at last year, pray together, and set our ministry goals for the year ahead.
Pack a jacket for the morning session outside. Lunch is provided, and the office closes for the day.

features.title: Year-End Giving Statements
text: Giving statements go out this month. Most givers get theirs by email, and the rest get a printed copy in the mail.
If someone calls about a statement, take their name and number and send it to the finance team. Please do not read gift amounts over the phone.

features.title: Easter Planning Starts Now
text: Easter is six weeks away, and it is our biggest Sunday of the year. Every service at every campus will be full, so every team needs more hands.
Ministry leads, please send your volunteer needs to your campus pastor by Friday. Invite cards arrive next week.

features.title: Easter Volunteers: Three Weeks Out
text: We still need greeters, parking crew, and kids volunteers for Easter. Check the Group Scheduler for open spots on your teams.
Thank you for every invite you have made. Many first-time guests on Easter came because a friend asked.

features.title: Holy Week Schedule
text: Good Friday services are at 6:30 PM at every campus, and four campuses hold an egg hunt on Saturday morning. Easter services are at the usual times.
The office closes at noon on Friday. Have a restful Saturday, because Sunday will be full.

features.title: Easter Recap: Thank You
text: What a Sunday. Our campuses welcomed hundreds of guests, and many of them filled out a connection card.
Our care team will follow up this week. If you met someone new, add a note to their profile in Rock so the right person reaches out.

features.title: Baptism Sunday Is Coming
text: Baptism Sunday is a week from this Sunday. People sign up through the Baptism Interest form on the website, and a pastor calls each one.
We need towel volunteers and a few people to help families take photos after each service.

features.title: VBS Needs Volunteers
text: Vacation Bible School is eight weeks away, and registration is open. We need crew leaders, snack helpers, and a few people who love to run games.
Students in grades 7 to 12 can serve too. Send anyone who is interested to the kids team.

features.title: VBS Week Is Here
text: VBS starts this week. Expect a full parking lot every morning and a lot of happy noise in the kids wing.
Please keep the hallways near the kids rooms clear, and use the side door between 8:30 and 9:30.

features.title: Student Camp Next Week
text: Our students leave for camp next week. The buses leave from the Phoenix campus on Monday morning.
Please pray for the students and leaders. The student team will be out of the office all week.

features.title: Praying for the Mission Team
text: Our high school mission team serves this week. They will help a partner church run a day camp for kids.
Look for their daily photo updates in the staff chat, and keep them in your prayers.

features.title: Serve Sunday This Week
text: This Sunday team leaders set up tables in the lobby after every service, and new volunteers sign up on the spot.
Staff, please stop by your teams' tables and help them welcome new volunteers.

features.title: Groups Launch Next Month
text: New small groups launch in about four weeks. Group Finder already lists the new groups, and Small Group Connect is the Sunday before launch.
If you know someone who is ready to lead, send their name to the groups team. Group Leader Training is ten days before launch.

features.title: Built on the Rock: Four Sundays to Go
text: Commitment Sunday for Built on the Rock is four Sundays away. The sermon series starts this Sunday at every campus.
Commitment cards and envelopes are in each campus office. Online commitments open the same day on the Pledge page.

features.title: Commitment Sunday Is This Week
text: This Sunday every family is invited to make a Built on the Rock commitment. Ushers will collect cards at the end of each service.
The finance team counts the cards on Monday. Please keep every card sealed and in the locked bags.

features.title: Commitment Sunday: Thank You
text: Thank you for a wonderful Commitment Sunday. Families gave with joy, and the pledge totals are now in Rock.
Each family who made a commitment gets a thank you letter this week. The first progress update goes out next quarter.

features.title: Fall Festival in Two Weeks
text: The fall festival is our favorite night to meet neighbors. Four campuses hold one, and we expect hundreds of families.
We need help with games, the candy trail, and the welcome tent. Bring a friend and a lawn chair.

features.title: Thanksgiving Week
text: The office closes Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving. Thank you for the food drive boxes that filled the lobby all month.
We are grateful for each of you and the work you do for our church.

features.title: Christmas Eve Planning
text: Christmas Eve is about six weeks away. Every campus has services at 3:00, 4:30, and 6:00, and each one needs more greeters, parking crew, and kids volunteers.
Ministry leads, please send your volunteer needs to your campus pastor by the end of the week.

features.title: Staff Christmas Party Friday
text: Our staff Christmas party is this Friday night. Spouses are welcome, and dinner starts at 6:30.
Bring a wrapped gift under 20 dollars if you want to play the gift swap.

features.title: Christmas Week Schedule
text: Christmas Eve services run at 3:00, 4:30, and 6:00 at every campus. The office closes from Christmas Eve through New Year's Day.
Merry Christmas. Thank you for all you have done this year.

evergreenFeatures.title: Sunday Wins
text: Last Sunday a family who moved here last month checked their kids in for the first time and joined a small group the same week.
Keep sharing your wins in the staff chat. They remind us why we do this work.

evergreenFeatures.title: Keep Your Rock Profile Current
text: Please check your own profile in Rock. Make sure your photo, phone, and staff bio are up to date.
Our website pulls staff bios and photos straight from Rock, so a change shows on the site the same day.

evergreenFeatures.title: Close the Loop on Connection Requests
text: When someone asks to serve or join a group, they are waiting for a call from us. Please check your open connection requests each week.
If a request is past due, call or text the person today, then add a note in Rock.

evergreenFeatures.title: This Week at All Staff
text: All Staff is Tuesday at 9:00 in the main conference room. We will hear a story from the kids team and review the month's calendar.
Bring your calendar and one win from your ministry.

evergreenFeatures.title: Weekend Service Planning
text: Service planning is Wednesday at 10:00 in the studio. Worship, production, and the campus pastors plan the next three Sundays.
Send announcement requests to the communications team by Tuesday noon.

evergreenFeatures.title: Rock Office Hours
text: Have a question about Rock? Office hours are the third Thursday of each month at 2:00, in the conference room or online.
Bring a report you want to build or a page you want to change, and we will work on it together.

evergreenFeatures.title: Praying for Our City
text: This week we are praying for the schools near each campus: the teachers, the staff, and the students.
If a school near you has a need, tell your campus pastor. A few small groups are ready to help.

evergreenFeatures.title: Invite Cards Are In
text: New invite cards for the current sermon series are at the welcome desk of every campus.
Take a stack for your team. A card in hand makes it easy for anyone to invite a friend.

evergreenFeatures.title: Thank a Volunteer This Week
text: Our volunteers make every Sunday happen. This week, write one handwritten note to a volunteer on your team.
Thank you cards and stamps are at the front desk.

evergreenFeatures.title: Following Up With First-Time Guests
text: Every first-time guest gets a welcome email the Monday after their visit, and a campus pastor calls each family that week.
If you meet a guest on Sunday, introduce them to someone on their campus team before they leave.

evergreenFeatures.title: Celebrate This Month
text: We have a few staff birthdays and work anniversaries this month. Cake is in the break room on Thursday afternoon.
Take a minute to thank the people who make your week easier.

evergreenFeatures.title: Background Check Renewals
text: Every kids and students volunteer renews a background check every two years. Rock shows each team leader whose check expires soon.
Please check your team this week, and send renewals to the kids team office.

evergreenFeatures.title: New Reports in Rock
text: The Leadership reports now include Ready to Lead, a list of people who serve, are in a group, and could lead one.
Open it under Reports in Rock, and bring questions to Rock office hours.

evergreenFeatures.title: Weekend Debrief
text: What worked last Sunday, and what did not? Share one thing in the staff chat by Tuesday noon.
Service planning reads every note before the Wednesday meeting.

evergreenFeatures.title: Meals for Families in Need
text: The care team is setting up meals for two families this month: a new baby and a family facing surgery.
If your small group can bring a meal, sign up at the care desk.

evergreenFeatures.title: Front Desk Coverage
text: Our front desk needs help over lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays. An hour a week makes a big difference.
Talk to Alisha if you can take a shift.

evergreenFeatures.title: Small Group Coaches
text: Each coach checks in with three to five group leaders a month. A short call or a coffee goes a long way.
Coaches meet at the next Leader Huddle to share what they hear.

evergreenFeatures.title: Monday Devotional
text: Before the week gets busy, read Psalm 23 and take five quiet minutes.
We will pray together at the start of All Staff on Tuesday.

articles.author: raman/priya
articles.title: From Priya: Statements This Month
articles.text: Year-end giving statements go out by the end of January. Givers who chose paper statements get them by mail, and everyone else gets an email with a link.

articles.author: raman/priya
articles.title: From Priya: Statement Questions
articles.text: Statements are out. If a giver asks about a missing gift, send them to the finance team, and we will check the batch it came in.

articles.author: holloway/greg
articles.title: From Greg: Retreat Goals
articles.text: Before the retreat, write down one thing that went well in your ministry last year and one thing you want to change.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: Easter Parking Plan
articles.text: Easter parking overflows into the school lot next door. Staff, please park there too, and leave the close spots for guests.

articles.author: brooks/rachel
articles.title: From Rachel: Easter Kids Check-In
articles.text: On Easter we open two extra check-in stations in the lobby. If you can help a new family print their labels, find me at the kids desk.

articles.author: castillo/naomi
articles.title: From Naomi: Easter Choir
articles.text: The Easter choir rehearses on Thursday nights for the next five weeks. Anyone on staff who sings is welcome to join us.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: Easter Setup
articles.text: The facilities team sets up the egg hunt on Friday afternoon. Please keep the back field clear after 1:00.

articles.author: morrow/kelsey
articles.title: From Kelsey: Easter Run Through
articles.text: The full Easter run through is Saturday at 4:00. Every campus watches the same video, so the stream team starts at 3:30.

articles.author: navarro/dee
articles.title: From Dee: Baptism Follow-Up
articles.text: After Baptism Sunday, every person who was baptized gets a call from a pastor and a framed photo. Help us get the photos printed by Wednesday.

articles.author: brooks/rachel
articles.title: From Rachel: VBS Check-In
articles.text: VBS uses the same kids check-in as Sunday. Families who register online get their labels faster, so point every family to the registration page.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: VBS Room Setup
articles.text: We turn the kids wing into a jungle on Saturday. Please clear your things out of rooms 101 to 108 by Friday afternoon.

articles.author: brooks/rachel
articles.title: From Rachel: VBS Safety
articles.text: Every VBS volunteer wears a lanyard and has a background check. If you see an adult without a lanyard in the kids wing, walk them to the front desk.

articles.author: silva/isaac
articles.title: From Isaac: Camp Is Next Week
articles.text: Camp is next week. Our student staff will be out all week, so send student questions to the front desk, and we will call back when we return.

articles.author: silva/isaac
articles.title: From Isaac: Mission Team Prayer
articles.text: Please pray for our team's safe travel and for the kids they meet at the day camp. We will share stories when we get home.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: Serve Sunday Tables
articles.text: Serve Sunday tables, banners, and sign-up cards are in the storage room by the loading dock. Please return them by Monday.

articles.author: pierce/jamal
articles.title: From Jamal: Leader Training
articles.text: Group Leader Training is on the Thursday ten days before launch, at 6:30. Every new leader needs it before their group starts, and coaches are welcome too.

articles.author: raman/priya
articles.title: From Priya: Counting the Cards
articles.text: The finance team counts commitment cards on Monday morning. Two people count every bag, and the totals go into Rock that afternoon.

articles.author: raman/priya
articles.title: From Priya: Pledge Progress
articles.text: Pledge progress now shows on the Pledge Analytics page in Rock. Campus pastors can see how their campus is doing any time.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: Festival Setup
articles.text: We set up the fall festival tents on Friday at 3:00. Many hands make it go fast, so stop by if you can.

articles.author: navarro/dee
articles.title: From Dee: Hope for the Holidays
articles.text: The holidays are hard for people who are grieving. Hope for the Holidays meets on the first Thursday of December, so invite anyone who lost someone this year.

articles.author: brooks/rachel
articles.title: From Rachel: Christmas Eve Kids
articles.text: Christmas Eve kids rooms are open for every service. We need eight more volunteers at each campus, so please ask your teams.

articles.author: raman/priya
articles.title: From Priya: Year-End Gifts
articles.text: Gifts must arrive or post by December 31 to count for this year. Mailed checks count by their postmark date.

articles.author: delgado/ray
articles.title: From Ray: Holiday Building Hours
articles.text: The buildings close from Christmas Eve after the last service until January 2. The alarm codes do not change.

articles.author: brooks/rachel
articles.title: From Rachel: Safety Training Saturday
articles.text: Volunteer safety training is this Saturday at 9:00. Every new kids and students volunteer needs it before their first Sunday.

evergreenArticles.author: brooks/rachel
evergreenArticles.title: From Rachel: Check-In Labels
evergreenArticles.text: Kids check-in labels now print allergies in red. If a label looks wrong, reprint it from the kiosk and let the kids desk know.

evergreenArticles.author: brooks/rachel
evergreenArticles.title: From Rachel: Security Codes
evergreenArticles.text: A child goes home only with an adult who shows the matching security code. Please never make an exception, even for a family you know well.

evergreenArticles.author: delgado/ray
evergreenArticles.title: From Ray: Lights and Doors
evergreenArticles.text: If you are the last one out, check that the side doors are locked and the lights in the worship center are off.

evergreenArticles.author: delgado/ray
evergreenArticles.title: From Ray: Room Requests
evergreenArticles.text: Please book rooms in Rock at least a week ahead. Last minute requests are hard to set up, and some rooms need chairs moved.

evergreenArticles.author: delgado/ray
evergreenArticles.title: From Ray: Air Conditioning Work
evergreenArticles.text: We change the air filters on Thursday. The worship center may run warm for an hour in the afternoon.

evergreenArticles.author: delgado/ray
evergreenArticles.title: From Ray: Parking Lot Striping
evergreenArticles.text: The north lot gets new stripes on Saturday. Please park in the south lot on Friday night and Saturday.

evergreenArticles.author: raman/priya
evergreenArticles.title: From Priya: Expense Reports
evergreenArticles.text: Expense reports for last month are due Friday. Attach a photo of each receipt, and code each one to your ministry's account.

evergreenArticles.author: raman/priya
evergreenArticles.title: From Priya: Online Giving
evergreenArticles.text: More than half of our givers now give online. If someone asks how to set up a recurring gift, send them to the Give page.

evergreenArticles.author: raman/priya
evergreenArticles.title: From Priya: Budget Check-In
evergreenArticles.text: Ministry budget reports for the quarter are in your inbox. Let me know by Friday if anything looks wrong.

evergreenArticles.author: pierce/jamal
evergreenArticles.title: From Jamal: Group Finder
evergreenArticles.text: Group Finder shows every open group with room. If a group is full, ask the leader to close it, so new people find one with room.

evergreenArticles.author: silva/isaac
evergreenArticles.title: From Isaac: Student Night
evergreenArticles.text: Student Night is every Wednesday at 6:30. We had a record crowd last week, so we are adding a few more small group leaders.

evergreenArticles.author: castillo/naomi
evergreenArticles.title: From Naomi: New Songs
evergreenArticles.text: We are teaching a new song this month. The lyrics and charts are in the shared drive if your team wants to learn it.

evergreenArticles.author: morrow/kelsey
evergreenArticles.title: From Kelsey: Live Stream
evergreenArticles.text: The live stream starts five minutes before each service. If you see a problem during a service, text the production team.

evergreenArticles.author: navarro/dee
evergreenArticles.title: From Dee: Care Requests
evergreenArticles.text: When someone shares a hard need, enter a prayer request or a note in Rock. The care team checks both every morning.

evergreenArticles.author: peak/daniel
evergreenArticles.title: From Daniel: Newsletter Deadline
evergreenArticles.text: Each campus newsletter goes out on Thursday. Send anything you want in it to the communications team by Tuesday at noon.

evergreenArticles.author: marble/alisha
evergreenArticles.title: From Alisha: The Church Calendar
evergreenArticles.text: Every public event needs an entry on the church calendar in Rock. Add yours at least four weeks ahead, so it can go in the newsletters.
